menu.words: expose board.usb: open the enclosure wall for the arduino uno r3's usb connector so a usb-b plug plugs in with the enclosure closed

evidence.quote: Case closed, a USB-B plug, shell and moulded handle both, must go right into the receptacle through a single opening in the end wall with 0.3 mm or more between it and the case on every side, and the opening can be no more than 1.5 mm larger than the plug on any side.

menu.words: expose board.dc: open the enclosure wall for the arduino uno r3's dc connector so a dc plug plugs in with the enclosure closed

evidence.quote: Case closed, a 5.5 x 2.1 mm DC barrel plug including its moulded handle must go fully into the jack via a separate opening in that same end wall while the USB plug is in as well, keeping 0.3 mm or more clear of the case all round, and the opening can exceed the plug by 1.5 mm at most on any side.

menu.words: set the lid closure to rebate: a flat plate that drops into a rebate in the top of the walls, flush with the upstand

evidence.quote: Build the case from a base and a separate lid that can be removed: the lid is a flat plate sitting in a rebate cut in the top of the walls (2 to 3 mm plate, 0.15 to 0.35 mm gap per side as fit, upstand of at least 1 mm), held by four M3 self-tapping screws that go into four bosses in the base.

menu.words: stop: keep the design as it is (the failing requirements above stay failing)
